'''Bobb Skype''' was a resident of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Comlink">{{InsiderCite|88|Comlink}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Phonebook.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Bobb Skype's name in a phonebook]]
Bobb Skype was introduced in the "[[Comlink (department)|Comlink]]" department of the [[Star Wars Insider 88|eighty-eighth issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="Comlink" /> which was published on [[June 13]], [[2006]].<ref name="Date">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20060518.html|text=The Sith Rule ''Star Wars Insider'' #88}}</ref> The magazine published the question of a fan who asked why [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] name was not changed if he was supposed to be kept hidden from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The question was followed by a comical illustration of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] looking for Skywalker's name and address in a phonebook, in which Bobb Skype's name was also present.<ref name="Comlink" />
